enforcement.write_behavior: Fail closed unless a fresh admission reference is supplied; bind updates to the exact current preimage SHA-256; atomically replace; write a digest receipt; mandatory post-write guarded recontact.
enforcement.recall_behavior: Read object bytes and verify the matching sidecar receipt path and SHA-256; on mismatch raise MEMORY_DRIFT_DETECTED_QUARANTINE_REFUSE.
enforcement.drift_re_admission: Allowed only when the observed current bytes match the explicitly supplied preimage SHA-256 and fresh scoped admission is supplied.
enforcement.legacy_objects: Not automatically migrated; existing memory objects without matching sidecar receipts fail closed when read through the new guarded recall method.

cache_safety.observed_issue: raw content endpoint returned stale baseline bytes after drift mutation
cache_safety.authoritative_path: GitHub Contents API GET with Cache-Control: no-cache
cache_safety.required_rule: Treat GitHub Contents API response, current commit head, blob SHA, and recomputed payload digest as the preimage; do not trust raw/CDN cached bytes for admission.

interpretation: This execution configures and integrates fail-closed preimage/digest checks into the two identified RAWMAC local memory write entry points, adds guarded recall methods, verifies drift refusal and a fresh re-admission follow-on write on a dedicated canary in the actual local memory directory, and separately performs and recontacts a follow-on write on the GitHub-backed storage canary from RAWMAC and SELFPI. It does not claim every uninspected consumer in the ecosystem is routed through these methods, nor that a separate remote SELFSERVE service has been deployed.
authority_effect: Evidence receipt only. It grants no authority for unrelated or future memory writes.
